title: haworthiopsis × lisbonensis
intro: Haworthiopsis × lisbonensis, commonly known as the Lisbon Haworthia, is a hybrid plant species within the Asphodelaceae family. This succulent plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in its ability to improve air quality and purify the atmosphere, removing pollutants such as formaldehyde, benzene, and trichloroethylene. The therapeutic actions of the Lisbon Haworthia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of this plant.
